def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    orig=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import defaultdict
    last={}  # col -> last bar row that used it as gap
    for r in range(H):
        row=g[r]
        cols=defaultdict(list)
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=0: cols[v].append(c)
        for v,cs in cols.items():
            if len(cs)<2: continue
            segs=[]; s=p=cs[0]
            for c in cs[1:]:
                if c==p+1: p=c
                else: segs.append((s,p)); s=p=c
            segs.append((s,p))
            if len(segs)<2: continue
            gaps=[c for c in range(segs[0][0],segs[-1][1]) if row[c]==0]
            for a,b in segs[1:]:
                for c in range(segs[0][1]+1,b): row[c]=v
            for c in gaps:
                for rr in range(last.get(c,-1)+1, r+1): g[rr][c]=v
                last[c]=r
    # extend existing vertical lines upward to meet bars
    for c in last:
        col=[orig[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        nz=[r for r in range(H) if col[r]!=0 and r>last[c]]
        if not nz: continue
        top=min(nz); w=col[top]
        # check contiguous vertical
        for rr in range(last[c]+1, top): g[rr][c]=w
    return g
